camel_example: aliyun agentloop POST /agentspace/my-agent-space/contextstore/my-context-store/context/search --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body '{"query":"用户最近的偏好设置"}' --version 2026-05-20 --force
kebab_example: aliyun agentloop search-context --agent-space my-agent-space --context-store-name my-context-store --query '用户最近的偏好设置' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchContext

parameters.help_en: The name of the AgentSpace. The length must be 2 to 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.help_en: The name of the context store. The length must be 2 to 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库名称，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: context_store_name

parameters.help_en: The structured filter conditions. The key is the field name, and the value is the expected match value
parameters.help_zh: 结构化过滤条件，key 为字段名，value 为期望匹配的值
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to apply structured formatting to the returned results
parameters.help_zh: 是否对返回结果做结构化格式化
parameters.name: formatted

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include memories with sourceState=inactive. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否包含 sourceState=inactive 的记忆，默认 false
parameters.name: include_inactive

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of returned results based on the top-N similarity
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果数量上限（相似度 Top-N）
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The retrieval query text. Natural language is supported
parameters.help_zh: 检索查询文本，支持自然语言
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The retrieval options used to control the retrieval strategy
parameters.help_zh: 检索选项，控制检索策略
parameters.name: retrieval_option

parameters.help_en: The recall scope. If a field with the same name exists in the filter, a 400 ScopeFilterConflict error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 召回 scope；与 filter 中同名字段冲突时返回 400 ScopeFilterConflict
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en: Filters results by extraction strategy IDs. Multiple IDs in the list are evaluated with an OR logic. If this parameter is not specified, all strategies are recalled. An empty list returns a 400 error. Valid IDs with no matches return empty results. Historical removed strategy IDs are supported
parameters.help_zh: 按提取策略 Id 过滤，列表内 OR；不传召回所有策略，空列表返回 400；格式合法但无匹配的 Id 返回空结果，支持历史已移除策略 Id
parameters.name: strategy_ids

parameters.help_en: The similarity threshold. Results with a similarity score below this value are filtered out. Valid values: 0 to 1
parameters.help_zh: 相似度阈值，低于该值的结果将被过滤，取值范围 0-1
parameters.name: threshold
